forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M443NN55C6HTFT2F2REPFZA1
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9780'
+title: 'Bind the composer to the SessionModel prompt helper: pending user message, cancel, both echo orders'
+---
+## What
+Source: update.md §4.2 ("Prompt helper"), §4.7 ("Composer"), §5 (`PromptResponse.messageId`).
+
+- [ ] `PromptInputView` (`Sources/AgentViewKit/Input/PromptInputView.swift`) and `ThreadActionTasks.swift` send with `SessionModel.prompt(_:meta:)`. The model adds a local pending user message at once (`SendState.pending`), so the composer adds no row of its own.
+- [ ] The stop button calls `SessionModel.cancel(meta:)`.
+- [ ] `UserMessageView` shows the send state: pending, sent, failed.
+- [ ] `PromptQueue` sends the next queued prompt only after the current prompt returns.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] After send, the user message shows at once as pending, and becomes sent when the agent links its `messageId`.
+- [ ] The result is the same when the echo comes before the response and when it comes after the response.
+- [ ] A failed prompt marks the message as failed and adds an error row.
+- [ ] Stop sends `session/cancel`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Input/ComposerSessionModelHostedTests.swift`: the two echo orders (use the echo-after option of `ScriptedWireAgent`); a failed prompt; stop sends `session/cancel` (assert on the frames of the scripted agent).
+- [ ] `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
